content: The GLEU scores can be seen in Table TABREF13 . We calculated GLEU for both formal and informal style models for all three languages. For English our model's best score was 45.9 and for Estonian it was 38.1. Latvian corrected output in fact get worse scores than the original uncorrected corpus, which can be explained by smaller training corpora and worse MT quality for Latvian (see Table TABREF6 ).
